title: Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes 🕺 Dance and Move | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: Touch your head, shrug your shoulders, bend your knees and wiggle your toes! Ollie the octopus leads Bibi and Bingo the puppy in a gentle body-part dance song for toddlers and preschoolers. Move along, copy every action and dance round and round with a new tune and new words.
actions: Touch your head and wave to the sky
Shrug your shoulders and give a hug
Bend your knees low and pop up
Touch your head, toes, tummy and nose, then dance round and round
credit: Original song by Tiny Tune Town: new words and music.
